candidates.title: LiteLLM v1.108.4
candidates.summary: > [!TIP] > The `lts` image tag always points to the latest LTS release. Pull `ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:lts` to stay on the newest LTS patch ## Verify this release ```bash cosign verify \ --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \ ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.108.4 ``` Same command for `litellm-database`, `litellm-non_root` and the `docker.io/litellm/*` images ## What's new in 1.108.4 (LTS) 10 PRs. 7 fixed, 1 changed. No action needed to upgrade ### Changes - **AWS Bedrock:** Fixed 400s from GLM, GPT-6 Luna and Nova 2 on Bedrock when the conversation carries Claude's signed thinking (#50399) - **AWS Bedrock:** Changed `/bedrock`

candidates.title: Claude Code v2.1.321
candidates.summary: ## What's changed - Added Claude Fable 5.2 (`claude-fable-5-2`), now the default Fable model — 1M context, $8/$40 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads - Added `--settings ` to `claude remote-control`, which applies a settings file to every session it starts; if the file changes, no new session starts until you restart `claude remote-control` - Fixed MCP OAuth requests sending secrets such as refresh tokens to another host when a server redirected them - Fixed a case where a read-only Bash command ran outside the sandbox without a permission prompt - Fixed a case where Bash permission checks judged a file write from the wrong folder and didn't prompt - Fixed deny rules and protected-file prom

candidates.title: Ollama v0.40.16
candidates.summary: ## Ripple Preview [Ripple Preview](https://ollama.com/library/ripple-preview) from Ricursive Intelligence is a 65B dense model built for agentic coding. ```sh ollama run ripple-preview ``` ## What's Changed - Qwen3.8 Flash Next uses about 27 GiB less memory on Apple silicon - `ollama launch claude` always routes Claude Code to the selected model - `ollama launch` explains when a cloud model has been retired - `/v1/responses` respects `truncation` and no longer silently truncates by default - `/v1/models` returns an empty list instead of `null` when no models are installed - CUDA 13.5 support for Windows on ARM - Updated llama.cpp **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/compare/v
